_comment: Settings of tools/drift_check.py (P59), kept outside Git as /etc/cloud-drift-check/config.json on the production host. source: a read-only clone of this repository (the check runs git fetch, never pull or push). Each stack names where its running commit is recorded: coolify_service (the 'Source commit' description written by tools/coolify_native.py), profile (a JSON deployment profile or receipt, key 'commit') or container (a running container prefix whose image tag or revision label is the commit). served: public addresses whose content must equal a local file. Sample values only.
